event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
JPN 223687 was represented by Genki KAHARA.
Technical Committee was represented by Dan Zhao.
Ikutro Mori (sailor of JPN 228221) attended the hearing as interpreter for JPN 223687
Yoichi Iijima coach of JPN 223687 attended the hearing as an observer.
Alexandra Pasi (member of the Technical Committee) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: JPN 223687 finished race F3 of the gold fleet in 5th place and was inspected by the Technical Committee at the finishing line.
Technical Committee found the free end of the vang attached to the centreboard retention shock cord.
After equipment inspection JPN 223687 untied the end of the vang.
Technical Committee stated that attaching the free end of the vang to the centerboard retention shock cord may provide a possible advantage, although the advantage is not certain.
conclusions: By having the free end of the vang attached to the centreboard retention shock cord JPN 223687 broke class rule 3. b) x and therefore broke rule 78.1
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons a starting penalty of 20% was decided
There were no circumstances to justify increasing nor decreasing the penalty.
The penalty given to JPN 223687 is a 20% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in RRS 44.3(c ) and applied to race F3, but not worse than the score of DNF
